title: Vibrant Light Mediterranean Pappardelle Pasta
description: A light and refreshing Mediterranean dish featuring pappardelle pasta, perfect for a lazy Sunday, with a grassy and emulsified sauce that is raw-friendly.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pappardelle pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large bowl, whisk together the olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and black pepper to create an emulsified sauce.
Add the chopped fresh basil to the bowl and stir to combine.
Drain the cooked pappardelle pasta and add it to the bowl, tossing to coat the pasta with the sauce.
Stir in the grated parmesan cheese until well combined.
Add the halved cherry tomatoes to the bowl and toss gently to combine.
Season the pasta with additional salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the Vibrant Light Mediterranean Pappardelle Pasta immediately, garnished with additional basil if desired.
